sinopsis.es: Kelly, una maestra joven, empieza a trabajar en una escuela pública de las afueras de Contagem. Idealista, intenta empujar un cambio y termina yendo demasiado lejos. Durante una clase discute con Nicolas, un alumno. De la pelea sale un aprendizaje: Kelly entiende que en la periferia de Brasil la excepción es la regla, y Nicolas, que solo derribando el presente se alcanza a ver el futuro.
sinopsis.en: Kelly, a young teacher, starts working at a public school on the outskirts of Contagem. Idealistic, she tries to push for a change, but ends up going too far. During a lesson, she gets into an argument with Nicolas, a young student. The quarrel brings some learning: Kelly learns that, on the outskirts of Brazil, the exception is the rule; and Nicolas learns that only by tearing down the present can the future be seen.
